lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows across the lateral flank, with the highest-intensity maxima clustered posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like arrangement in the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or truncated section is visible at the posterior apex of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (consistent with remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral midline posterior to the pectoral fin.
